- Contract

sources.title: Re's Quests
sources.text:
Jump to Eridani, Eridani Farming, Ultra Drago, The World.
Quest Location: Eridani
Quests Begun From: Re (NPC)
Requirements: Must have completed the 'No Good Deed' quest.
Note: These quests can only be completed once.
The Black Goat in The Dark
The Star Sinks into the Sea
The Gentlest Truth
Time Moves the Moon
Looks like I'm your Watson, Detective Champ. How about we circle back to check on that mom and widower? They were worried about you so go and tell them you're doing swell. While you're at it, mind thinning the mobs of….people? I'll take one half and you can have the other.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
No biggie, you'll forget about them by tomorrow.
Items Required:
Creature 15 Hunted x1
Dropped by Creature 15
Creature 16 Hunted x1
Dropped by Creature 16
Creature 34 Hunted x7
Dropped by Creature 34
Rewards:
6,000 Gold
15,000 Exp
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Thanks for making the town a bit quieter. That makes it a lot safer for that little girl and that guy on the street to come out of hiding. Why not check on them, too? I'll go make sure the others are… feeling better.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
What a cute little plush? Can I have it? Pwetty pwease?
Items Required:
Creature 30 Hunted x1
Dropped by Creature 30
Creature 31 Hunted x1
Dropped by Creature 31
Rewards:
3,000 Gold
7,000 Exp
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
There goes the town. At least that means there's no one left to get angry at you for not burying the bodies. Oh. Wait. The MAYOR might get mad at us for skipping town. If he turned out anything like the others… he's probably looking for us. We should find him first.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Wow.
Items Required:
Door x1
Dropped by Door
Mayor Found x1
Walk to Screen 10
Rewards:
3,000 Gold
7,000 Exp
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
It's do or die, not like it's been anything but this. However you want to handle this, I got your back, champ. And remember, I never lie.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
[Re makes a Confetti Noise with her mouth]
Items Required:
Creature 6 Hunted x1
Dropped by Creature 6
Rewards:
9,000 Gold
22,000 Exp
Quest Location: Eridani
Quests Begun From: Re (NPC)
Requirement: Must have completed the 'Time Moves the Moon' quest.
Note: Quest name is a parody of Sweet Dreams (Are Made of This) by Eurythmics.
Sweet Dreams Are Made of Teeth
Time to put on your tooth fairy costume and go get me some teeth, Hero! Just beat them out of any monsters you run into. No time for questions, go GO!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
More content for my channel!
Items Required:
Tooth x28
Wisdom Tooth x4
Rewards:
1,500 Gold
1,500 Exp
Items:
Teeth x1
Quest Location: Ultra Drago
Quests Begun From: Re (NPC)
Requirements: Must have completed the 'Mahapadma' quest.
Note: This quest can only be completed once per week.
Drago, Tyrant of Astravia
I'd say you have about 3 minutes until Judgement arrives. You'd better kick Drago's butt before then, or else it's game over for you!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Do a pose for me so I can snap some pics to show La!
Items Required:
Drago Dethroned x1
Dropped by King Drago (Monster)
Rewards:
200,000 Gold
500,000 Exp
Items:
King Drago Insignia x5
Quest Location: The World
Quests Begun From: Re (NPC)
Requirements: Must have completed the 'Temptation, Reversed' quest.
Note: These quests can only be completed once.
The Tower
The Star
The Moon, Reversed
The Sun, Reversed
Judgement
The World
For Song, it's been one heartbreak after another. Just when she thinks she's found a home, she's kicked out for being a monster or it bursts into flames. And now it's all going to come crashing down again. I hate that we're making you do this but Song needs to see that the Scale isn't on the right track, and never has been. You'll have to fight her, but hold back a bit. She's not a fighter, she's just desperate.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I don't know how we were deluded into thinking we were doing the right thing for so long. Even before we started to attack Astravia, Song pulled innocent people into the Garden to experiment on. All on Darkon's orders. They let Re…No, they let me run rampant doing whatever I wanted. I'm sorry Song, we have to wake up.
Items Required:
So Battled x1
Dropped by So
Rewards:
20,000 Gold
50,000 Exp
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
The Fool's influence is weakening faster and faster, which means The World's picking up speed. The Nothingness eating up Lore is right behind us. We'll plummet through empty space before you get a chance to see Darkon. Go and push the Nothingness back! Punches and kicks worked pretty well. Don't think too much about it. I'll keep Fa and Ti from stopping you.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
If you didn't wander into the Garden, where would we be right now? Somewhere in paradise where the sun never sets? Where even a tick like Drago would be all hugs and kisses? I don't want that fakey stuff. I want the real sun, the real hope you've given us for a better Lore. Now I'm all sad thinking about all the fun we'd have if you arrived twenty years earlier. Haha, would you still be in diapers?
Items Required:
Nothingness Abated x10
Dropped by Nothingness
Rewards:
10,000 Gold
25,000 Exp
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Song won't back down. She stood back up to protect Darkon from you. Even though she's the smartest of us, deep down, Song knows this is wrong. But, she's still a kid scared of being alone again. I…I can't help you fight Song like this. Even if I had my full strength, I don't think I'd be able to raise my voice against her. Please, can you tucker her out?
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I'm scared too. After all we've done, I don't know what's going to come after the end. But, I want the others to live on. I want them to look forward, and only glance back. Titania, Aurola, and I will still be there for them, in their happy memories.
Items Required:
So Defeated x1
Dropped by So
Rewards:
20,000 Gold
50,000 Exp
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Song…She's on her last legs. There's no way she can stop you, and she knows it. I feel it coming off of her in waves - hopelessness for the future. Champ, just one more time. Let her down gently so she can move on.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
It's time Darkon sees the light.
Items Required:
So Fully Defeated x1
Dropped by So
Rewards:
20,000 Gold
50,000 Exp
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
This is between you and Darkon. I'll keep the rest of the Scale from interfering, not that any of us have the ability to get in between you two. We've all been through a lot, and made a crazy amount of mistakes along the way. If all Astravians are going to be judged, then it's our turn next. Go make Darkon face the music.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
If I don't get some karma for mistakes I know I've made, it'll bother me until I'm dead. I'd be guilty, and paranoid that my comeuppance is going to arrive eventually. It's a relief that you came to stop us before it's too late. If I can think like this, I hope that means there are still good parts of me that exist. Could you do me a favor and think of Darkon that way too?
Items Required:
Darkon Defeated x1
Dropped by Darkon (Monster)
Rewards:
80,000 Gold
100,000 Exp
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Is that the Primordial World up there? Everything, all of Darkon and the Scale's efforts, are coming full circle. A perfect Lore built on regret and resentment is on its way. I can't live like that. You'd have to make me. Darkon will force everyone to live his way if you don't stop him. Go on, champ! This is your story too. Work your magic like you always do and defeat Darkon. Save Lore!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Hey Champ, after this is all over, will you think about us from time to time?
Items Required:
Encore Darkon Defeated x1
Dropped by Encore Darkon
Rewards:
80,000 Gold
100,000 Exp
A Requiem for the Wicked Character Page Badge
Begin this quest in our free web game at www.AQ.com!

We've all been through a lot, and made a crazy amount of mistakes along the way. If all Astravians are going to be judged, then it's our turn next. Go make Darkon face the music.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
If I don't get some karma for mistakes I know I've made, it'll bother me until I'm dead. I'd be guilty, and paranoid that my comeuppance is going to arrive eventually. It's a relief that you came to stop us before it's too late. If I can think like this, I hope that means there are still good parts of me that exist. Could you do me a favor and think of Darkon that way too?

Darkon Defeated x1
Dropped by Darkon (Monster)
Rewards:
80,000 Gold
100,000 Exp

quests.name: The World
requirements: Must have completed the 'Temptation, Reversed' quest.
Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Is that the Primordial World up there? Everything, all of Darkon and the Scale's efforts, are coming full circle. A perfect Lore built on regret and resentment is on its way. I can't live like that. You'd have to make me. Darkon will force everyone to live his way if you don't stop him. Go on, champ! This is your story too. Work your magic like you always do and defeat Darkon. Save Lore!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Hey Champ, after this is all over, will you think about us from time to time?
Items Required:
Encore Darkon Defeated x1
Dropped by Encore Darkon
Rewards:
80,000 Gold
100,000 Exp

Clio, the Liar
Melpomene, the Inevitable
Erato, the Inconsolable
Thalia, the Truth
Dismantling the summoning chamber is going to take a good chunk of elbow grease, even with you and me. There should be tools to help us in the storage. The guards stationed in the Menagerie Display area also take care of storage. They switch out decorations throughout the seasons. One of the creatures in that room should have the storage key, assuming they weren't able to escape.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Drago built this glorious narrative around himself, all lies. His trophies of war were stolen achievements, bought by the sacrifices of his people. I know he's planning to leech off of you next.
Items Required:
Storage Key x1
Dropped by Creature 20
Rewards:
4,000 Gold
10,000 Exp
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
I hate to do this to my former compatriots but they won't let us into the storage room if they're awake. Mind helping me knock them out with the dull side of your blade? I know it's a lot more effort than it looks like its worth, what with the destruction happening around us. But impending doom doesn't mean we should give up.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Take a break, you lot! Today is just another bump in the road, not the end of it. I wish you well when you wake.

Guards Incapacitated x8
Dropped by Astravian Royal Guard (Monster)
Rewards:
4,000 Gold
10,000 Exp
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
We're in the storage room…Apologies, I was caught up in old memories. My voice sounds funny? Don't tease me like that! Come now, the tools we need are in the boxes. Grab them, stomp the spiders biting your ankles, and we'll get moving. How do spiders get so big? There's nothing to catch but dust bunnies.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I wonder how they got his piano in here. Does it fold like an accordion?

Crates Searched x3

Spiders Exterminated x8
Dropped by Storage Spider

4,000 Gold

I'm going to need you to stall him for as long as possible while I try to damage the magical nodes in the summoning chamber. Talk to him… see if he'll give you any information, and then return to me.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
He.. he wouldn't even FIGHT you? All these years and I still couldn't make a difference.

Talk to Darkon x1
Talk to Darkon on Screen 10
Rewards:
0 Gold
5,000 Exp

The Past and the Present

- When Completed
Thank you for bringing our friend back, Hero.

1,000,000 Gold
1,000,000 Exp

You have both the past and present versions of Astravia Castle? I don't know how that is possible, but I should expect nothing less from the Dragon of Time! With some help, I might be able to combine them. And by that I mean Darkon's help of course.

- When Completed
Enjoy your new home! We will drop by sometimes.

Dropped by Encore Darkon

0 Exp

You have helped me, so now I will help you - to rank up into the Dragonslayer elite and earn your full place in the Order of Dragonslayers! You are, right now, officially a Dragonslayer Recruit. To rank up to Dragonslayer Veteran, bring me 8 Dragonslayer Veteran Medals. You can get them from Wyverns and Water Draconians!

- When Completed
Good work!

Dragonslayer Veteran Medal x8
Dropped by:
Water Draconian (Version 1)
Wyvern (Monster) (1)

500 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Nightly.
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Congratulations! You are now a Dragonslayer Veteran. To rank up to Dragonslayer Sergeant, you must bring me 8 Dragonslayer Sergeant Medals. You can find them on Purple, Venom and Bronze Draconians.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Well done!

Dragonslayer Sergeant Medal x8
Dropped by:
Bronze Draconian
Purple Draconian
Venom Draconian
Rewards:
550 Gold
550 Exp
Thanks to Nightly.
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
As a Dragonslayer Sergeant, you now have quite a bit of experience fighting these creatures. To rank up to Dragonslayer Captain, bring me 8 Dragonslayer Captain's Medals that you can get from Dark and Golden Draconians!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I am truly impressed.

Dragonslayer Captain's Medal x8
Dropped by:
Dark Draconian
Golden Draconian
Rewards:
600 Gold
600 Exp
Thanks to Nightly.
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
You have made it this far-- to the rank of Dragonslayer Captain! Now, your final test awaits! Bring me 8 Dragonslayer Marshal Medals by defeating the powerful fire dragon 8 times! Do this, and your rank as Dragonslayer Marshal is secure-- You will be one of my top-ranking slayers!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You are the best of the best.
Items Required:
Dragonslayer Marshal Medal x1
Dropped by Red Dragon (Monster)
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
1,000 Exp
Thanks to Nightly.
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
With Vasalkar slain, most of his treasure will be donated to the towns he destroyed. But some items are too powerful to be in the hands of anyone but a Dragonslayer. Collect 12 Wisps of Dragonspirit for me and I will reward you with a piece from the Dragon's Hoard!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Congratulations! You have proven that you are truly a great Dragonslayer!

Wisp of Dragonspirit x12
Dropped by:
Bronze Draconian
Dark Draconian
Golden Draconian
Purple Draconian
Red Dragon (Monster)
Venom Draconian

Rewards:

500 Exp

Before we take on Vasalkar. I'm going to need enough Dragonbane for all of our Dragonslayers. We make it from Draconic Ore. The best way to get this ore is from the Wyverns and Draconians, who have mined it for their own uses. Plus. you'll be slaying some Dragonkin - two birds, one stone!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Perfect. Stick around, and you'll be using some of our Dragonbane yourself!

Dark Draconian
Golden Draconian
Purple Draconian
Venom Draconian
Water Draconian (Version 1)
Wyvern (Monster) (1)
Rewards:
500 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Aeryn.
Requirements: Must have completed the 'Dragonslayer Marshal' quest.
Dragonslayers sometimes use dragon scales in their armor. It helps protect us from the fiery breath of the dragons we fight. Bring me scales from the Wyverns and Draconians in the area so I can keep us all well-protected.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Remember, we can always use more.

Dragons take pride in killing Dragonslayers! They keep trophies from each of us that they slay - can you believe that?? We must defend the honor of the fallen. Slay the Dragonkin inside Vasalkar's lair, and bring back any trophies you find.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Their deaths have been avenged.

Dragon Trophy x3
Dropped by:

Dark Draconian
Golden Draconian
Purple Draconian
Venom Draconian

Wyvern (Monster) (1)
Rewards:
300 Gold
300 Exp
Thanks to Aeryn.

Vasalkar is a huge, old, and deadly Red Dragon that has destroyed many villages. He guards his treasure hoard ferociously! Defeat him so that we may carry word of vengeance back to the people who have suffered! Bring me his heart, and I'll reward you for it. You might also find rare and valuable treasures in his hoard!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You truly have what it takes to be one of our order.

Dragon Heart x1
Dropped by Red Dragon (Monster)
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
1,000 Exp

- When Completed
Well done! Not bad for a first try.

Greenguard Dragon Slain x1
Dropped by Greenguard Dragon
Rewards:
10 Gold
10 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x3
Thanks to rickyb20.
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Let's face it, most heroes have defeated the Greenguard Dragon before. Read for something a little more challenging? The next Dragon Gladiator you'll be facing is Ssikari! Get in there and impress me!

- When Completed
Excellent! I could hear the clash of stell and scale from here!

Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp

Alright, to get you started, the first Dragon Gladiator I'd like to see you fight is the Greenguard Dragon. I expect him to be a challenge, but if you fight well I know you'll emerge victorious.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Well done! Not bad for a first try.
Items Required:
Greenguard Dragon Slain x1
Dropped by Greenguard Dragon
Rewards:
10 Gold
10 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x3
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay Ssikari
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Let's face it, most heroes have defeated the Greenguard Dragon before. Read for something a little more challenging? The next Dragon Gladiator you'll be facing is Ssikari! Get in there and impress me!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Excellent! I could hear the clash of stell and scale from here!
Items Required:
Ssikari Slain x1
Dropped by Ssikari (Level 20)
Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x3
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay Arradia
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
You've done well against the Greenguard Dragon and Ssikari. Let's see how you'll fare against a dragon made entirely out of crystal. Be warned, his crystal skin is much harder to cut through than scales are.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You defeated him quickly, and didn't even damage your blade!
Items Required:
Arradia Slain x1
Dropped by Arradia (Level 24)
Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x3
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay the Void Dragon
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Next you'll be fighting a dragon that we brought back from the Void. Its terrifying appearance is enough to throw many heroes off their game, but if you can remain calm and focused I have no doubt you'll defeat it.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Good, good! You may want to visit Cleric Joy and make sure nothing's going to burst from your chest.
Items Required:
Void Dragon Slain x1
Dropped by Void Dragon (Level 28)
Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x5
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay the Shadow Dragon
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Next in line is a dragon who breathes shadow instead of fire. A solid shield, while useful against flame, may not help as much in this fight. My advice? Stay out of the way of its breath.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You dodge flaming shadow like a champion.
Items Required:
Shadow Dragon Slain x1
Dropped by Shadow Dragon (Level 32)
Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x5
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay Razorclaw
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Razorclaw is beautiful in appearance, but makes a fierce adversary. What look like delicate feathers are sharp enough to cut. I recommend a very long blade for this battle.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Impressive, hero. Maybe you're ready for some real challenges.
Items Required:
Razorclaw Slain x1
Dropped by Razorclaw (Level 36)
Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x5
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay Trigoras
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
You knew this guy was going to show up eventually. How could I create the ultimate dragonslaying challenge without Trigoras? Show me what you can do against a dragon with three heads!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Not bad! Nothing shows off your agility like fighting a 3-headed dragon.
Items Required:
Trigoras Slain x1
Dropped by Trigoras (Level 40)
Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x7
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay the Chaos Dragon
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
I hope you enjoyed that 3-headed dragon fight, because I have another one ready for you. And this one is an incredibly powerful chaos beast, too!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Fantastic!
Items Required:
Chaos Dragon Slain x1
Dropped by Chaos Dragon (1) (Level 46)
Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x7
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay Stalagbite
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Ready for something a little more complex? Your next adversary is Stalagbite. In there with him are a handful of chaorrupted dark elves. They'll attack you immediately, and if you don't take down Stalagbite fast enough, more will come.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I am truly impressed!
Items Required:
Stalagbite Slain x1
Dropped by Stalagbite (Level 50)
Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x10
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay Frost Fang
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Like Stalagbite, Frost Fang doesn't fight alone. His frozen minions will protect him fiercely. It would be an impossible battle for most, but you've quickly proven that you can handle anything.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I knew this fight would give you no trouble.
Items Required:
Frost Fang Slain x1
Dropped by Frost Fang (Level 55)
Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x10
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay Dreadmaw the Defiler
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Dreadmaw the Defiler waits for you, Hero… Galanoth once bested him and used his head as a trophy. Can YOU defeat him?
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You have earned your victories, Hero! All of Lore shall sing your praises!
Items Required:
Dreadmaw Slain x1
Dropped by Dreadmaw the Defiler
Rewards:
50 Gold
50 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x10
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay the Avatar of Desolich
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.
Looking to hone your skills even further? The Avatar of Desolich and his dracolich minions await you. Don't go alone to face this battle, hero.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Invigorating, wasn't it? If you come back tomorrow, the dragons will be reconstructed and you can try again!
Items Required:
Desolich Slain x1
Dropped by Avatar of Desolich (Level 60)
Rewards:
1,500 Gold
1,500 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x20
Thanks to rickyb20.

quests.name: Slay Desoloth
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Note: This quest can only be completed once per day.
Still looking for a bigger challenge? Go into the coliseum to face Desoloth and the elemental dragons of the DragonPlane. You'll want to bring some friends along for this one.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
What an exciting battle! If you come back tomorrow, the dragons will be reconstructed and you can try again!
Items Required:
Slay Desoloth x1
Dropped by Desoloth the Final (Level 60)
Rewards:
1,500 Gold
1,500 Exp
Items:
DragonSlayer Trophy (Misc) x20
Thanks to rickyb20.

requirements: Rank 10 Dragonslayer (Class).

Chaos Fluffy

Requirements: Rank 10 Dragonslayer (Class).
If you wish to become a dragonslayer general, you'll need to put in the time and effort to prove yourself. Slay 12 of the dracoliches here to hone your skills.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Hmmm. Promising indeed. You just might do. Here, take this Enchanted Scale. Once you have 100 of them AND you are a fully trained DragonSlayer, you'll be able to ascend to the ranks of DragonSlayer General.
Items Required:
Dracolich Slain x12 (Stacks up to 120)
Dropped by:

Tempest Dracolich (Level 40)

Aid the cause, Hero! Take out 1 of each Dracolich species to thin their ranks.

Excellent. With enough slain dracoliches, we'll destroy this horde!

quests.name: Battleon DragonSlayer
quests.text:
Bring me some trophies from defeating the dracoliches to show your help to the Order of DragonSlayers. Then, defeat Chaos Fluffy and bring me its head.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Your support towards the Dragonslayers hasn't gone unrecognized. Take some of our gear. You might need it for the next wave.
Items Required:
Dragon Claw x3
Draco War Medal x10
Chaos Fluffy's Head x1 (Stacks up to 6)
Dropped by Chaos Fluffy
Rewards:
500 Gold
500 Exp
You will receive one of the following:
Battleon DragonSlayer
Battleon DragonSlayer Helm
Battleon DragonSlayer Helm and Scarf
Battleon DragonSlayer Cape
Battleon DragonSlayer Spear of Poking
Battleon DragonSlayer Light Decal x1
Battleon DragonSlayer Dark Decal x1
Male Dragonslayer House Guard x1
Female Dragonslayer House Guard x1
Thanks to Sammzy.

quests.name: Town On Fire
requirements: Must have completed the 'Sledge-a-tarian' quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the 'Sledge-a-tarian' quest.
This is a low blow, bounty hunter! Making me watch it all burn again - I can't do it. Would you help me, friends? Put the fires out, and maybe then I'll have the strength to face Akriloth again.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
The smoke is finally clearing. Thank you.
Items Required:
Fires Put Out x6
Dropped by:
Fire Pile
Floating Flame
Rewards:
800 Gold
800 Exp
Thanks to Apus.

quests.name: My Greatest Foe
quests.text:
Requirement: Must have completed the previous quest.
Note: This quest can only be completed once.
This is a test of my resolve. In order to get out of here, I'm going to have to face Akriloth again. Maybe with you all by my side… this time we will win.
Items Required:
Akriloth Confronted x1
Get Akriloth's Head down to 85% of its HP
Dropped by Akriloth's Head
Rewards:
250 Gold
250 Exp
Thanks to Apus.

quests.name: Infernus the Eight-Eyed
quests.text:
Infernus the Eight-Eyed is a terrible beast. He is responsible for devouring 5 entire flocks of sheep in the last week alone. If he keeps this up, the nearby villages will starve in less than half a year.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You have defeated Infernus! Keep on fighting him to gather the materials you need for Senna to craft your items.
Items Required:
Infernus Defeated x1
Dropped by Infernus
Rewards:
800 Gold
800 Exp
Items:
Dragon Scales x5
Thanks to rruurruu77.

quests.name: Blackrawk Magebane
quests.text:
15 years ago, Blackrawk Magebane took over one of the only known caverns of FlameCrystals. These are prized by mages everywhere for their ability to create invisible heat and flames that do not burn. But Blackrawk has prevented ANY from harvesting the crystals for years.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You have defeated Blackrawk! Keep on fighting him to gather the materials you need for Senna to craft your items.
Items Required:
Blackrawk Defeated x1
Dropped by Blackrawk
Rewards:
800 Gold
800 Exp
Items:
Dragon Scales x5
Thanks to rruurruu77.

quests.name: Smoldur Blastfang
quests.text:
Smoldur Blastfang… this beast, I have encountered before. It has developed a special taste for DragonSlayers, and goes out of it's way to follow us as we move about Lore. Slay this Dragon and you will go down in DragonSlayer history!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You have defeated Smoldur! Keep on fighting him to gather the materials you need for Senna to craft your items.
Items Required:
Smoldur Defeated x1
Dropped by Smoldur
Rewards:
800 Gold
800 Exp
Items:
Dragon Scales x5
Thanks to rruurruu77.

quests.name: Guts for Glutes
quests.text:
Note: This quest can only be completed once.
Now, friend! Gut this gargantuan horror while I block its flame!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
We can't give up now!
Items Required:
Fight Glutus x1
Dropped by Glutus
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
800 Exp

quests.name: Mucus be Joking
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Before we go any further, we're going to want to protect ourselves from Glutus' stomach acid. What protects against stomach acid? That's right, mucus! Collect some from the Mucus in his mouth. We'll slather it on our armor to slow the corrosion
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I know it's disgusting, but when people's lives are at stake, we do what we must!
Items Required:
Dragon Mucus x7
Dropped by Mucus
Rewards:
700 Gold
500 Exp

quests.name: Build a Bone-a-fied Ladder
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Glutus has a pretty long esophagus! Just dropping down into his stomach could be dangerous, so we'll need to build a ladder and climb down. Grab some of the rope stuck in his teeth - I guess he uses it to floss? - and get some nice, long arm and leg bones from the Skeletal Slayers. (Once per login session)
+ When Completed
- When Completed
There we go! Perfect!
Items Required:
Rope Floss x2
Click on the blue arrows around the map
Nice Long Bones x10
Dropped by Skeletal Slayer
Rewards:
800 Gold
500 Exp

quests.name: Talk About Reflux
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Note: This quest can only be completed once.
Now we can descend to Glutus' stomach! We don't want to wait for him to pass us naturally - we would be dissolved by his stomach acid by then. So we'll look around for something that might help us escape more quickly,
Items Required:
Ticket Out Of Here x1
Click the skeleton on screen 7
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
500 Exp

quests.name: How'd HE get here?
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
A lost Dragonslayer! He may have some valuable information that could help us solve our dragon problem! Talk to him, and hear what he has to say.
Items Required:
Hear Falgar's Story x1
Talk to Falgar on screen 7
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
500 Exp

quests.name: Glutus, Take 2
requirements: Must have completed the 'Cha Cha Cha' quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the 'Cha Cha Cha' quest.
Before, you said Glutus was too big for you to damage. That is no longer the case. Take him down. NOW, and we'll make sure this never happens to anyone else.
Items Required:
Glutus Slain x1
Dropped by Deflated Glutus
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
500 Exp

quests.name: Defeat the Drakel
quests.text:
Do you see how far they're willing to go to keep these people in line? We must send a message that this village is now under our protection! Come back to me when you've slain 10 of the militant beasts. I'll be doing the same.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
That won't be the last of them.
Items Required:
Drakel Defeated x10
Dropped by Storm Drakel
Rewards:
800 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Fxmbrute13.

quests.name: Don't Get Zapped
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
There's a lot of stray electrical energy in the village in the form of ball lightning, both from the storms and from the Drakel's electric prods. If any of it touches the wet ground, it could have deadly results! Get rid of the Ball Lightning, and keep the villagers safe.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I'm sure it'll eventually reform, but for now, the risk of being electrocuted has significantly decreased.
Items Required:
Ball Lightning Destroyed x10
Dropped by Ball Lightning
Rewards:
800 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Fxmybrute13.

quests.name: Get Grounded
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
How do you protect against lightning and electricity? With grounding. And what's the best way to ground against electricity? With rubber. Luckily, Rubber Treeants are native to this area! Collect rubber from them, and bring itback to me. I have a plan.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
That's enough to start with, thank you.
Items Required:
Treeant Rubber x6
Dropped by Rubber Treeant
Rewards:
600 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Fxmybrute13.

quests.name: Get the Key
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
You've noticed all the villagers are barefoot? They're telling me that the Drakel require it, so they'll be more vulnerable to their shock prods. Their boots are all kepy in a locked supply cellar. The Cellar Guard will have the key. Get it from him.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Well done.
Items Required:
Cell Key x1
Dropped by Cellar Guard
Rewards:
500 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Fxmybrute13.

quests.name: Get the Boots
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Now, all you need to do is use the key to open the cellar door. Then, go in and get the boots. As many as you can find. Bring them back to me, and I'll coat them in the rubber we collected earlier. That will make it harder for the Drakel to electrocute people.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Great! I hope that's enough for everyone.
Items Required:
Cellar Opened x1
Click on the blue arrow in Screen 5
Sturdy Boots x6
Click on the blue arrows around the map
Rewards:
250 Gold
250 Exp
Thanks to Tris.

quests.name: Make Lightning Rods
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
There's just one last thing we need to do before we free all of the villagers. Fight the Storm Drakel and take their electric prods. Then, embed them in the ground. They will act as lightning rods, drawing any electricity to themselves instead of the villagers.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Good work.
Items Required:
Electric Prod x8
Dropped by Storm Drakel
Lightning Rod Put Up x8
Click around the map
Rewards:
800 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Fxmybrute13.

quests.name: Free the Villagers
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
It's time to act! Down the road a ways, you'll find holding pens where the villagers are held captive, guarded by Drakel. Get the keys to the pens from the Drakel Guards. Then, open the doors to free the captive villagers.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Excellent!
Items Required:
Drakel Key x4
Dropped by Drakel Guard
Villagers Freed x4
Click on the blue arrows around the map after collecting the Drakel Keys
Rewards:
600 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Tris and Lord Vordred 101.

quests.name: Open the Gate
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
They've locked the gate to stop us from following them up the mountain! We'll have to get the key from the Elite Guard if we're going to get it open!
Items Required:
Gate Key x1
Dropped by Elite Guard (1)
Gate Open x1
Click on the gate in Screen 8
Rewards:
800 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Tris and Lord Vordred 101.

quests.name: Fight Your Way Through
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Valsarian is at the top of this mountain! We'll have to fight our way to the peak to confront him! Slay any Storm Drakel who get in our way!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
They never stood a chance.
Items Required:
Storm Drakel Slain x12
Dropped by Storm Drakel
Reach Valsarian x1
Go to Screen 13
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Tris.

quests.name: Defeat Valsarian
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
This is our chance! Attack the beast now, and we free Darkmoor Village from his tyranny!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Finally, Darkmoor Village is free.
Items Required:
Valsarian Slain x1
Dropped by Valsarian
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
500 Exp
Thanks to Fxmybrute13.

quests.name: Looting is for Sneevils
quests.text:
Note: This quest can only be completed once.
This area is overrun with Sneevils! Now that the dragon has been slain, they must be looting whatever was left behind. There can't be much be much value left, but maybe they'll have some sort of clue. Steal their boxes from them, and bring them back here.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Alright, let's see what we can find in here.
Items Required:
Sneevil Boxes x8
Dropped by Sneevil Looter
Rewards:
300 Gold
150 Exp
Thanks to Exreal.

quests.name: Jumping in Puddles
requirements: This quest can only be completed once.
Auto turn-in.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Notes:
This quest can only be completed once.
Auto turn-in.
Well, it's better than nothing, eh? Based on what that note says, I think that following the puddles of water will lead us to the treasure room. Let's go take a look!
Items Required:
Treasure Room Found x1
Go to screen 5.
Rewards:
150 Gold
150 Exp
Thanks to Fxmybrute13.

quests.name: Pick the Right Chest
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Note: This quest can only be completed once.
These aren't treasure chests - they're mimics! If there are any clues to be found here, it will surely be in one of these, but we'll have to be careful.
When we first came in, it looked like one of these mimics had something inside it, but now I can't tell which one it is. Open the right one, and you'll find the clue. Open the wrong one, and you might lose an arm!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Well, that wasn't what I expected.
Items Required:
Find a Clue
Click on the second chest on the right on screen 5.
Rewards:
500 Gold
250 Exp
Thanks to Exreal.

quests.name: Gelatin is Nasty
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Note: This quest can only be completed once.
Gah! This cave is full of Jelly-like Cubes! We've got to take care of these things quickly, or they'll dissolve any evidence our culprit may have left behind!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You didn't get any on you, did you?
Items Required:
Jelly-like Cubes Slain x10
Dropped by Jelly-Like Cube (Version 2)
Rewards:
600 Gold
150 Exp
Thanks to Exreal.

quests.name: Explore the Cave
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:

- When Completed
I understand that we are in dire straits and have little room to find a moment of peace…It's just that I haven't seen you this hostile with monsters before. There hasn't been a single smarty snark from you, is there something wrong?

Mega Timestream Medal x3 (Stacks up to 300)
Dropped by all monsters in Timestream War
Rewards:
1,500 Gold
8,000 Exp
You may also receive, at random:
Prismatic Seams x1

quests.name: Teary Components
requirements: Must have completed either of the previous quests.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed either of the previous quests.
Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.
You can't tell that the creatures spawned from the Timestream have your voice. Or, they do in a manner of speaking. I've never heard you sound this upset before. No one understands the noises they're making either. It's just a jumble of noise. Still, for anyone that has stood shoulder to shoulder with you…fighting them is demoralizing. It could settle their minds if we grab some Mumblers and found out more about them.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I'm no expert in magic, so the mages Queen Victoria sent to help us spelled it out in layman's terms. They compared the Timestream to a body, though they're unsure if the Avatars have a similar relationship to the Planes. The creatures spawned from the Timestream are actually being expelled from ‘its body.' They're unwanted parts of itself that it's trying to get rid of. I don't know how this links to their voices sounding like yours.
Items Required:
Temporal Residue x3 (Stacks up to 36)
Dropped by Mumbler (Monster) (Version 2)
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
3,000 Exp

quests.name: Proportional Retaliation
requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Note: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 25%.
The monsters corrupted by Shadowflame are being affected by the Mana Affliction, supposedly because Malgor lost control of the Mana Core. They're in the late stages, which means they can explode at any moment. That's not doing our morale any favors. Our allies are worried for their loved ones in the early stages of Mana Affliction. We should learn more about the Shadowflame monsters' conditions.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
There is a purpose behind this. That is the conclusion the magical experts among our allies have come to. Something is controlling how fast we go through the stages of Mana Affliction. Anything corrupted by Shadowflame is speeding through the stages and popping. As for our friends, they're going through the stages much slower. I'm choosing to take this as a good sign.
Items Required:
Mana Secretion x5 (Stacks up to 60)
Dropped by:
Decaying Locust (Version 2)
Distorted Imp (Version 2)
Mumbler (Monster) (Version 2)
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
3,000 Exp

quests.name: Growing Pains
requirements: This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 75%.
This quest can only be accepted on Screen 5 before completing it for the first time.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Notes:
This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 75%.
This quest can only be accepted on Screen 5 before completing it for the first time.
We're beginning to see the Mumblers transform. They're growing wings, draconian features, and their speech is becoming intelligible. Our discomfort with their voices aside, these False Wyverns are sturdier and more hostile. They lash out blindly, and pose a serious threat if left alone. It hurts my pride but I will dearly need your help putting these Wyverns down. This isn't anything like hunting dragons.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
We need to be wary. There's nothing to suggest that this is the final stage of the Mumblers' growth. With how vast this Timestream is, a bigger threat is likely on the horizon. I'm used to listening for the roars of dragons in the distance. In fact, I can hear one now…it's just that I still can't handle its voice. I believe that this is a trick of some sort, because I believe you. Just, don't expect me to fight that one on my own.
Items Required:
Vestigial Wings x2 (Stacks up to 14)
Dropped by False Wyvern (Monster) (Level 80)
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
4,000 Exp

requirements: This quest can only be completed once.
This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 100%.
quests.text:
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Notes:
This quest can only be completed once.
This quest was unlocked when the War Meter reached 100%.
The monsters have been scattered, leaving a lone beast to approach. It's one of the Mumblers that have grown past the False Wyvern stage. They're draconian in appearance, stand on their hind legs, and are calling your name. Whatever they are, it's hostile and blocking our way. We have to defeat them before we can find Malgor. Be careful.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
My friend…have you always kept your fears to yourself?
Items Required:

Dropped by Second Speaker
Rewards:
30,000 Gold
150,000 Exp
